scientific_integrity: Original claim is exclusively the all-parameter global nonlinear branch enumeration, fixed nodal locations, amplitude/magnetization laws, and global free-energy minimizer classification. The general graphon spin fixed point, local eigenvalue bifurcations, and the coordinate-reflected boundary-value reduction are credited to preceding literature. Numerical checks are not treated as proof.
scientific_limitations: The result applies only to the stated zero-field ferromagnetic continuum Ising fixed point with the exact kernel W(x,y)=min(x,y), its entropy normalization and positive inverse temperature. It does not prove stochastic dynamic stability, finite-size corrections or metastable lifetimes. The same kernel under reflection and its ODE reduction are prior work in Searle–Tindall Appendix C. Publication priority of the full nonlinear branch classification remains subject to unindexed earlier global BVP analyses.
title: Complete nonlinear branches of the Ising model with a Brownian-covariance graphon
